title: Einstein-Kropina Metrics and Their Application in Finsler Gravity
summary: We generalize the Einstein condition for Kropina metrics obtained in the positive definite setting by Zhang, Shen and others to all signatures. As examples of Einstein-Kropina metrics $L=L_{a,b}$, we construct new explicit positive definite ones and the first ones with Lorentzian signature. Next, we classify all Einstein-Kropina solutions to the vacuum equation of Finsler gravity by Pfeifer and Wohlfarth, in arbitrary dimension and including a possible cosmological constant $Λ$.
